selectionReason.zh: 在 NASA、咖啡与猫三张独立照片上，选取空间响应方差总和最大的通道。已测试真实梯度输出；这是自动筛选的视觉联想候选，尚待小组确认，不是已命名的器官探测器。
selectionReason.en: Channel with the highest summed spatial response variance on independent NASA, coffee and cat photographs. Real gradient outputs tested; an automatically screened visual-association candidate pending group curation, not a named organ detector.

failureObservation.zh: 均匀灰色输入也可能产生纹理，说明形态联想不能证明识别出器官。微调验证准确率有限，未证明对日常照片或人体器官的泛化；所见纹理不保证符合预期。
failureObservation.en: A uniform gray input may also develop texture, showing that visual association is not evidence of organ recognition. Limited validation accuracy does not establish generalization to everyday photos or human organs; textures may not match expectations.
